description: Changes the connector's account's My Gear, in one call. add puts new pieces in; one the account already holds (same brand, name, and variant) comes back as already_have and is left as it was. update changes pieces by the ids get_my_gear gives, only the fields sent, null clearing one. A piece that names a catalog_id is linked to that catalog row: a new one takes its brand, name, variant, gear type, and weight, one already held keeps its own, and another product or size is refused; null unlinks it. remove puts pieces away by id: they stop being offered on lists, and the lists that still carry them will not bring them back. restore brings put-away pieces back. kit, on a piece added or updated, makes it a kit of other pieces by id (replacing what it held), and null on update turns a kit back into a single piece; a kit's weight is its items', so a kit takes own_weight_g, never weight_g. Each piece answers for itself, in the order sent, with a reason when it wasn't done as sent. What is added or changed here counts as the owner's own word on the piece, so a list saved later cannot overwrite it. Needs read-and-change access.

add.description: New pieces, each with a name or a catalog_id.

catalog_id.description: A catalog row from search_catalog. The piece takes the catalog's brand, name, variant, gear type, and weight, each unless given here; a name can be left out. Another product or size is refused.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for price, such as USD. Ignored without a price.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt.

kit.description: Makes the piece a KIT: a set kept together, such as a cook kit or a sleep system, that weighs its own weight plus its items'. items REPLACES whatever it held: pieces of My Gear by id, each with how many, none of them a kit (kits are one level deep), and a piece already in a kit can't become one. A piece can be in several kits. Not with weight_g: set own_weight_g for what the kit weighs by itself.

items.description: Everything the kit holds, replacing what it held: pieces of My Gear by id, each with a count.

count.description: How many of it the kit holds. Default 1, and never more than the piece's owned: a higher count is held to it, so raise owned first.

id.description: A piece of My Gear, from get_my_gear.

own_weight_g.description: What the kit weighs by itself, a stuff sack or a strap, in grams. Default 0.

name.description: The product or item name, without brand or variant.

owned.description: How many of it the owner has, when more than one: three of the same bottle is one piece with owned 3, not three pieces.

price.description: What one cost, in the currency's main unit: 199.95.

product_url.description: The maker's or a shop's page for it.

weight_g.description: Grams for one. 0 records it as not weighed yet.

remove.description: Ids of pieces to put away.

restore.description: Ids of put-away pieces to bring back.

update.description: Changes to pieces that exist, each by id.

catalog_id.description: Link or relink the piece to this catalog row, from search_catalog. It keeps its own name, brand, variant, gear type, weight, and kcal; the row replaces what an earlier link gave and fills the rest. Another product or size is refused (send variant to move sizes), and it never follows later catalog changes. Null unlinks it.

classification.description: base, worn, or consumable. Null clears it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for price, such as USD. Ignored without a price.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt. Null clears it.

kcal.description: Calories in one, for food. Null clears it.

kit.description: Makes the piece a KIT: a set kept together, such as a cook kit or a sleep system, that weighs its own weight plus its items'. items REPLACES whatever it held: pieces of My Gear by id, each with how many, none of them a kit (kits are one level deep), and a piece already in a kit can't become one. A piece can be in several kits. Not with weight_g: set own_weight_g for what the kit weighs by itself. Null turns a kit back into a single piece, weighing what the kit did; its items stay as the pieces they are.

items.description: Everything the kit holds, replacing what it held: pieces of My Gear by id, each with a count.

count.description: How many of it the kit holds. Default 1, and never more than the piece's owned: a higher count is held to it, so raise owned first.

id.description: A piece of My Gear, from get_my_gear.

own_weight_g.description: What the kit weighs by itself, a stuff sack or a strap, in grams. Default 0.

name.description: The product or item name, without brand or variant.

owned.description: How many of it the owner has, when more than one: three of the same bottle is one piece with owned 3, not three pieces. Null sets it back to one.

price.description: What one cost, in the currency's main unit: 199.95. Null clears it.

product_url.description: The maker's or a shop's page for it. Null clears it.

variant.description: Size, length, or rating: Long, 20F. Null clears it.

weight_g.description: Grams for one. 0 records it as not weighed yet.
